dashboard.description: 驾驶舱式完整结构 - 4 Rows (宏观/AI/组合/执行)

panels.title: 💰 Row 1: 顶级宏观概览 (Am I Rich or Poor?)

panels.description:
⚠️ PLACEHOLDER

需要: equity_pnl_snapshots 表

这是最重要的指标!显示今日/本周/本月/总计盈亏

targets.rawSql:
-- 今日 + 本周 + 本月 + 总计盈亏
-- ⚠️ PLACEHOLDER - Need equity_pnl_snapshots data
SELECT
    anyLast(realized_pnl) + anyLast(unrealized_pnl) as total_pnl
FROM trading.equity_pnl_snapshots
WHERE date = today()
-- Fallback: show 0 if no data
UNION ALL
SELECT 0 as total_pnl
LIMIT 1

panels.title: 💰 Total PnL (总盈亏)

panels.description:
✅ REAL DATA

来自: ai_trader_dash_metrics.oos_mdd

衡量风险承受能力的核心指标

targets.rawSql:
-- ✅ HAS DATA: Using OOS MDD from metrics
SELECT value * 100 as mdd_pct
FROM trading.ai_trader_dash_metrics
WHERE name = 'oos_mdd'
  AND date = today()
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: 📉 Max Drawdown (最大回撤)

panels.description:
✅ REAL DATA

来自: ai_trader_dash_metrics.oos_sharpe

衡量经风险调整后的收益

targets.rawSql:
-- ✅ HAS DATA: Using OOS Sharpe from metrics
SELECT value as sharpe
FROM trading.ai_trader_dash_metrics
WHERE name = 'oos_sharpe'
  AND date = today()
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: 📈 Sharpe Ratio (夏普比率)

panels.description:
✅ REAL DATA

显示核心服务状态:
- DQ (数据质量)
- Tools (工具健康)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    'DQ' as metric,
    CASE WHEN value = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as status
FROM trading.ai_trader_dash_metrics
WHERE name = 'dq_ok' AND date = today()
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
    'Tools' as metric,
    CASE WHEN value > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as status
FROM trading.ai_trader_dash_metrics
WHERE name = 'tools_running' AND date = today()
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: 🟢 System Status (系统状态)

panels.description:
✅ REAL DATA

最后的安全防线
0 = Active (正常)
>0 = 触发次数

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    value as events,
    CASE
        WHEN value = 0 THEN 'Active'
        WHEN value < 5 THEN 'Warning'
        ELSE 'TRIPPED'
    END as status
FROM trading.ai_trader_dash_metrics
WHERE name = 'guardian_events' AND date = today()
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: 🛡️ Guardian Status (守护者)

targets.rawSql:
-- ⚠️ PLACEHOLDER
SELECT
    ts as time,
    equity as value
FROM trading.equity_pnl_snapshots
WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
ORDER BY ts

panels.title: 🧠 Row 2: AI 模型表现 (Is the Brain Smart?)

panels.description:
⚠️ PLACEHOLDER

需要: trading_signals 表

显示模型信号 (-1到1) 的分布
明确信号 = 分布在±1附近
犹豫不决 = 集中在0附近

targets.rawSql:
-- ⚠️ PLACEHOLDER - Need trading_signals table
SELECT
    round(signal, 1) as signal_bucket,
    count() as frequency
FROM trading.trading_signals
WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL $time_range
  AND strategy_id LIKE '$strategy_id'
  AND symbol LIKE '$symbol'
GROUP BY signal_bucket
ORDER BY signal_bucket

panels.title: 📊 Signal Distribution (信号分布)

panels.description:
⚠️ PLACEHOLDER

需要: trading_signals 表

显示模型置信度 (0到1) 的分布
高置信度 = 模型确定
低置信度 = 模型不确定

targets.rawSql:
-- ⚠️ PLACEHOLDER
SELECT
    round(confidence, 1) as conf_bucket,
    count() as frequency
FROM trading.trading_signals
WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL $time_range
  AND strategy_id LIKE '$strategy_id'
  AND symbol LIKE '$symbol'
GROUP BY conf_bucket
ORDER BY conf_bucket

panels.title: 🎯 Confidence Distribution (置信度分布)

panels.description:
⚠️ PLACEHOLDER

需要: trading_signals + outcome 数据

验证模型有效性的关键!
高置信度交易应该有更高的胜率和盈亏

targets.rawSql:
-- ⚠️ PLACEHOLDER
SELECT
    floor(confidence * 10) / 10 as conf_range,
    count() as total_trades,
    countIf(outcome > 0) as wins,
    round(countIf(outcome > 0) / count() * 100, 1) as win_rate,
    round(avg(outcome), 2) as avg_pnl
FROM trading.trading_signals
WHERE executed = 1
  AND outcome IS NOT NULL
  AND ts > now() - INTERVAL $time_range
  AND strategy_id LIKE '$strategy_id'
  AND symbol LIKE '$symbol'
GROUP BY conf_range
ORDER BY conf_range

panels.title: 🏆 High-Confidence Performance (高置信度表现)
💼 Row 3: 投资组合风险 (What Are We Betting On?)

panels.description:
⚠️ PLACEHOLDER

需要: portfolio_snapshots 表

快速识别:
- 明星策略 (盈利多)
- 累赘策略 (亏损多)

targets.rawSql:
-- ⚠️ PLACEHOLDER
SELECT
    strategy_id,
    sum(pnl) as total_pnl,
    count() as trades,
    round(avg(pnl), 2) as avg_pnl_per_trade
FROM trading.portfolio_snapshots
WHERE date >= today() - INTERVAL $time_range
  AND strategy_id LIKE '$strategy_id'
GROUP BY strategy_id
ORDER BY total_pnl DESC

panels.title: 📊 Strategy PnL (各策略盈亏)

panels.description:
⚠️ PLACEHOLDER

需要: positions_snapshots 表

精确了解:
- 钱放在哪里
- 每个持仓的盈亏

targets.rawSql:
-- ⚠️ PLACEHOLDER
SELECT
    symbol,
    qty,
    entry_price,
    current_price,
    unrealized_pnl,
    round((current_price - entry_price) / entry_price * 100, 2) as pnl_pct,
    strategy_id
FROM trading.positions_snapshots
WHERE date = today()
  AND ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM trading.positions_snapshots WHERE date = today())
  AND strategy_id LIKE '$strategy_id'
  AND symbol LIKE '$symbol'
ORDER BY abs(unrealized_pnl) DESC

panels.title: 📋 Current Positions (当前持仓)
⚡ Row 4: 交易执行 (Are We Trading Efficiently?)

panels.description:
⚠️ PLACEHOLDER

需要: fills_live + order_events

滑点 = 隐性成本
过高滑点会严重侵蚀利润

targets.rawSql:
-- ⚠️ PLACEHOLDER
SELECT
    f.ts as time,
    (f.fill_price - o.limit_price) / o.limit_price * 10000 as slippage_bps,
    o.symbol
FROM trading.fills_live f
JOIN trading.order_events o ON f.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE f.ts > now() - INTERVAL $time_range
  AND o.order_type = 'LMT'
  AND o.strategy_id LIKE '$strategy_id'
  AND o.symbol LIKE '$symbol'
ORDER BY f.ts

panels.title: 💸 Slippage Analysis (滑点分析)

panels.description:
⚠️ PLACEHOLDER

需要: exec_events 表

显示转化率:
AI决策 → 风控 → 提交 → 成交

targets.rawSql:
-- ⚠️ PLACEHOLDER
SELECT
    stage,
    count(DISTINCT decision_id) as decisions
FROM trading.exec_events
WHERE date >= today() - INTERVAL $time_range
  AND details LIKE '%$strategy_id%'
  AND details LIKE '%$symbol%'
GROUP BY stage
ORDER BY
    CASE stage
        WHEN 'GENERATED' THEN 1
        WHEN 'RISK_CHECK' THEN 2
        WHEN 'SUBMITTED' THEN 3
        WHEN 'FILLED' THEN 4
        WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 5
    END
